CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m7_assigned_subtask_reviews()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, root_id uuid, node_id uuid, task_title text, subtask_title text, kind text, submitted_at timestamp with time zone, cash_blocked boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select w.id, w.root_id, w.node_id, t.title, s.title, w.kind, w.submitted_at,
    w.kind = 'completion' and w.submitted_as_lead and exists (
      select 1 from public.petty_cash_requests r
      where r.task_id = t.id and r.subtask_id = s.id
        and r.status not in ('settled', 'rejected', 'cancelled')
    )
  from eflow_m7.work_proposals w
  join public.tasks t on t.id = w.root_id
  join public.subtasks s on s.id = w.node_id and s.task_id = t.id
  where w.state = 'pending'
    and auth.uid() is not null
    and w.author_id <> auth.uid()
    and eflow_m7.work_scope_open(w.root_id, w.node_id)
    and eflow_m7.work_reviewer(w.root_id, w.node_id, w.author_id, w.kind) = auth.uid()
    and w.submitted_as_lead = eflow_m7.is_subtask_lead(w.root_id, w.node_id, w.author_id)
  order by w.submitted_at, w.id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.project_completion_readiness_internal(p_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; extra jsonb;
begin
  result:=eflow_budget.pre_subtask_budget_closeout(p_project_id);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','funding','id',c.id,'taskId',t.id,
    'title',s.title,'status','unused_subtask_funding','amount',public.subtask_cap_available(c.id),
    'detail','The Task Lead must return unused subtask funding to the parent task.')), '[]') into extra
  from public.work_budget_allocations c
  join public.subtasks s on s.id=c.subtask_id and s.task_id=c.task_id
  join public.tasks t on t.id=c.task_id and t.linked_project_id=p_project_id
  join public.projects p on p.id=t.linked_project_id and p.status in ('planning','active','on_hold')
  where c.status in ('pending','approved') and public.subtask_cap_available(c.id)>0;
  if jsonb_array_length(extra)=0 then return result; end if;
  return result||jsonb_build_object('blockers',result->'blockers'||extra,'canComplete',false);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_finance_review.head_can_post_settlement(l petty_cash_liquidations, r petty_cash_requests, actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select l.status='pending_department_settlement' and r.status='pending_department_settlement'
    and actor is distinct from l.submitted_by
    and actor is distinct from r.requester_id and actor is distinct from r.cash_recipient_id
    and (r.liquidation_due_at is null or l.submitted_at<=r.liquidation_due_at or l.department_decided_at is not null)
    and not exists (select 1 from public.petty_cash_liquidations newer
      where newer.request_id=r.id and newer.version>l.version)
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.organizations o
      join public.profiles p on p.id=o.head_user_id and p.org_id=o.id
      join eflow_finance_review.settlement_blocker_alerts a on a.head_id=p.id
      where o.id=r.org_id and o.is_active and p.id=actor and p.is_active and p.role='head'
        and a.liquidation_id=l.id and a.version=l.version
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1 from eflow_finance_review.eligible_settlement_officers(r,l.leader_decided_by,(
        select v.reviewer_id from public.liquidation_independent_reviews v
        where v.liquidation_id=l.id and v.version=l.version
      ))
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_liquidation_independent_review(p_liquidation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare l public.petty_cash_liquidations;r public.petty_cash_requests;v public.liquidation_independent_reviews;
 candidates jsonb;settlers integer; escalation_approver uuid; can_approve_escalation boolean; head_fallback boolean;
begin
 select * into l from public.petty_cash_liquidations where id=p_liquidation_id;
 select * into r from public.petty_cash_requests where id=l.request_id;
 if r.id is null or not eflow_finance_review.scope_allowed(r.org_id,auth.uid()) then
  raise exception 'Independent review access denied' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select * into v from public.liquidation_independent_reviews where liquidation_id=l.id and version=l.version;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.full_name,'appointment',
  case when p.id=o.head_user_id then 'Head' else 'Assistant Head' end) order by p.full_name),'[]'::jsonb)
 into candidates from public.profiles p join public.organizations o on o.id=r.org_id
 where eflow_finance_review.eligible_reviewer(r,p.id);
 select count(*) into settlers from eflow_finance_review.eligible_settlement_officers(r,l.leader_decided_by,v.reviewer_id);
 escalation_approver:=eflow_finance_review.staffing_escalation_approver(l,r);
 head_fallback:=coalesce(eflow_finance_review.head_can_post_settlement(l,r,auth.uid()),false);
 can_approve_escalation:=head_fallback or (l.status='pending_department_settlement' and r.status='pending_department_settlement'
   and escalation_approver is null and jsonb_array_length(candidates)=0
   and coalesce(eflow_finance_review.staffing_escalation_head(l,r,auth.uid()),false));
 return jsonb_build_object('liquidationId',l.id,'version',l.version,'required',eflow_finance_review.required(r) or v.id is not null,
  'review',case when v.id is null then null else to_jsonb(v) end,'candidates',candidates,'eligibleSettlers',settlers,
  'canReview',coalesce(v.reviewer_id=auth.uid() and eflow_finance_review.eligible_reviewer(r,auth.uid()),false),
  'canSettle',public.is_department_accounting_staff(r.org_id,auth.uid()) and public.has_permission(auth.uid(),'accounting.settle_liquidation')
   and not eflow_finance_review.conflicted(r,auth.uid()) and auth.uid() is distinct from l.leader_decided_by and auth.uid() is distinct from v.reviewer_id,
  'current',coalesce(v.fingerprint=eflow_finance_review.fingerprint(l,r),false),
  'headEscalationApproved',escalation_approver is not null,
  'headCanPostSettlement',head_fallback,
  'headSettlementPosted',r.status='settled' and l.status='approved' and exists (
    select 1 from eflow_finance_review.staffing_escalation_approvals a
    where a.liquidation_id=l.id and a.version=l.version and a.head_id=r.settled_by
  ),
  'headEscalationCommandId',case when escalation_approver=auth.uid() then (
    select a.command_id from eflow_finance_review.staffing_escalation_approvals a
    where a.liquidation_id=l.id and a.version=l.version and a.head_id=escalation_approver
      and a.fingerprint=eflow_finance_review.fingerprint(l,r)
  ) end,
  'headEscalationFingerprint',case when can_approve_escalation then eflow_finance_review.fingerprint(l,r) end,
  'headAlertStatus', case when settlers=0
    and l.status='pending_department_settlement' and r.status='pending_department_settlement' then (
      select case when h.id is null then 'no_head'
        when a.liquidation_id is not null then 'notified'
        else 'pending' end
      from public.organizations o
      left join public.profiles h on h.id=o.head_user_id
        and h.org_id=o.id and h.is_active and h.role='head' and o.is_active
      left join eflow_finance_review.settlement_blocker_alerts a
        on a.liquidation_id=l.id and a.version=l.version and a.head_id=h.id
      where o.id=r.org_id
    ) end,
  'escalationRequired',jsonb_array_length(candidates)=0 or settlers=0);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_finance_review.scope_allowed(org uuid, actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.profiles p join public.organizations o on o.id=org
  where p.id=actor and p.is_active and p.org_id=org and o.is_active
  and ((p.role='accounting_staff' and public.has_permission(actor,'accounting.settle_liquidation'))
    or (p.id=o.head_user_id and p.role='head') or (p.id=o.assistant_head_user_id and p.role in ('head','member','accounting_staff'))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_finance_review.fingerprint(l petty_cash_liquidations, r petty_cash_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select md5(jsonb_build_object('liquidation',jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'version',l.version,
  'spent',l.declared_spent,'returned',l.returned_amount,'refund',l.refund_receipt_number,'refundDate',l.refund_date,
  'submitted',l.submitted_at,'note',l.note,'payload',l.itemized_payload),
  'request',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'office',r.org_id,'requester',r.requester_id,'recipient',r.cash_recipient_id,
  'lead',r.task_leader_id,'task',r.task_id,'spent',r.released_amount,'currentLead',
   (select coalesce(t.recommendation_lead_id,t.assigned_to) from public.tasks t where t.id=r.task_id)),
  'receipts',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rc) order by rc.id) from public.petty_cash_receipts rc where rc.liquidation_id=l.id),
  'items',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) order by i.id) from public.petty_cash_receipt_items i
    join public.petty_cash_receipts rc on rc.id=i.receipt_id where rc.liquidation_id=l.id))::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.work_baseline(p_root uuid, p_node uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object(
  'revision',coalesce((select s.revision from eflow_r7.tree_state s where s.root_id=t.id),1),
  'rootStatus',t.status,'rootProgress',t.percent_complete,'lastActivity',t.last_activity_at,
  'nodeStatus',n.status,'nodeProgress',n.percent_complete
 )
 from public.tasks t left join public.subtasks n on n.task_id=t.id and n.id=p_node
 where t.id=p_root),(
  select jsonb_build_object('revision',coalesce((select s.revision from eflow_r7.tree_state s where s.root_id=t.id),1),
   'rootRevision',t.revision,'rootStatus',t.status,'nodeStatus',n.status,'nodeProgress',n.percent_complete)
  from public.personal_tasks t join public.personal_subtasks n on n.task_id=t.id and n.id=p_node
  where t.id=p_root));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_m7.work_scope_open(p_root uuid, p_node uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(eflow_r7.read_root(p_root),false) and coalesce(eflow_r3.eligible(auth.uid()),false)
 and (exists (
  select 1 from public.tasks t join public.projects p on p.id=t.linked_project_id
  where t.id=p_root and t.deleted_at is null and t.archived_at is null
    and t.status in ('in_progress','changes_requested') and p.status='active'
    and (p_node is null or eflow_m7.node_activated(t.id,p_node) and exists(
      select 1 from public.subtasks s where s.id=p_node and s.task_id=t.id and s.status not in ('for_review','completed')
    ))
 ) or exists(
  select 1 from public.personal_tasks t join public.personal_projects p on p.id=t.project_id
  join public.personal_subtasks s on s.task_id=t.id and s.id=p_node
  where t.id=p_root and p.status='active' and t.status='in_progress'
   and eflow_m7.personal_node_activated(t.id,s.id) and s.status not in ('for_review','completed')
 ));
$function$
